gloss: to crush; to smash; to kill (time); to waste

definitions.gloss: to crush; to smash; to squash
definitions.explanation: To press or squeeze something until it is flattened or destroyed.
To spend time in an idle or unproductive way.

definitions.gloss: to waste; to ruin; to spoil
definitions.explanation: To destroy the value or potential of something.

definitions.gloss: to shut down; to close (a business)
definitions.explanation: To cause a business or organization to fail.

examples.japanese: {空|あ}き{缶|かん}を{足|あし}で{潰|つぶ}した。
examples.english: I crushed the empty can with my foot.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}を{待|ま}つ{間|あいだ}、カフェで{時間|じかん}を{潰|つぶ}した。
examples.english: I killed time at a café while waiting for the train.

examples.japanese: せっかくのチャンスを{潰|つぶ}してしまった。

notes:
{潰|つぶ}す is transitive ({他動詞|たどうし}). The intransitive pair is {潰|つぶ}れる (to be crushed, to collapse).

ASPECT ({ている}):
{潰|つぶ}している indicates an ongoing action of crushing, or a progressive state of wasting.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {時間|じかん}を{潰|つぶ}す (to kill time)
- {店|みせ}を{潰|つぶ}す (to shut down a shop)
- {顔|かお}を{潰|つぶ}す (to make someone lose face)
- {声|こえ}を{潰|つぶ}す (to lose one's voice from overuse)

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- ～を{潰|つぶ}す: The object being crushed/wasted
- ～で{潰|つぶ}す: The means of crushing

This verb is very versatile and appears in many idiomatic expressions.
